contentPolicy.eventCopyRule: World-state player-facing copy belongs to this catalog or later approved localization content, not to WorldStateService hard-coded strings.
contentPolicy.technicalEffectRule: A world event may describe narrative pressure immediately, but it must not claim production, training, defense, decay, enemy-strength, reward, PvP, or save effects are applied until future engineering verifies a committed consumer.
contentPolicy.notificationRule: Notification IDs are source references only. Delivery, acknowledgement, deduplication, persistence, and accessibility remain #177 engineering work.
contentPolicy.durationRule: Durations, expiration, replacement, cancellation, priority, and offline resume are future #172 lifecycle contract behavior.

eventDefinitions.narrativeIntent: public danger at a defended settlement or gate
temporary realm morale and public gathering
foreshadowing and visible Veil instability without automatic reward or stat change
dangerous Void pressure that must remain visible without fabricated decay or enemy-strength mutation

draftLocalization.text: Siege
A settlement or gate is under direct threat and the realm must rally defenders.
Siege warnings are sounding. Defenders are needed, but gameplay effects are unavailable until the world-state contract verifies them.
The siege pressure has lifted. Confirmed recovery effects will appear only after the lifecycle contract exists.
Siege state is not available yet; no defense, production, reward, or save effect has been applied.
Realm Festival
A temporary public gathering raises morale and makes the realm feel alive between conflicts.
A realm festival has begun. Morale is high, but training or economy effects remain unavailable until verified by engineering.
The festival has ended. Any future benefits must close through the committed lifecycle contract.
Festival state is not available yet; no training, economy, reward, or save effect has been applied.
Veil Omen
A visible disturbance in the Veil foreshadows story pressure without automatically changing stats or rewards.
A Veil omen is visible in the sky. Treat it as a warning, not a completed gameplay effect.
The omen has faded, but its meaning remains in the story record.
Veil omen presentation is not available yet; no quest, reward, save, or world-state mutation has been applied.
Void Corruption
Void pressure spreads through the realm and must be treated as danger until a safe consumer contract applies effects.
Void corruption is spreading. Resource decay or enemy-strength effects remain unavailable until verified by engineering.
The corruption has receded. Recovery claims require the future committed lifecycle contract.
Void corruption state is not available yet; no decay, enemy-strength, reward, or save effect has been applied.
World Event Unavailable
World events need the lifecycle contract before they can persist, expire, or change gameplay state.
Effect Unverified
This event has narrative copy, but its gameplay consumer is not verified yet.
World Event Ended
The event has ended according to future lifecycle authority; no extra reward or penalty is implied by this copy.

requiredValidation: event IDs are unique and lowercase snake-case
legacyEffect values map only to supported WorldStateEffect enum names except None
all displayNameKey, summaryKey, startMessageKey, endMessageKey, unavailableMessageKey, and status keys resolve in draftLocalization
notificationDefinitionId values are treated as source references until #177 delivery exists
events with requested_unverified consumers cannot announce applied gameplay effects
duration, persistence, expiration, replacement, cancellation, and duplicate behavior fail closed until #172 engineering owns them
blockedRuntimeClaims: duplicate world event delivery is idempotent

optimizationImpact.performance: source-only JSON; no runtime service loop, ECS entity, scene, VFX, or allocation behavior added
optimizationImpact.memory: bounded catalog for four world events and three status-copy records
optimizationImpact.buildSize: small text-only addition; no binary assets
